title: Maelle - Expedition 33 Character Guide & Lore
description: Maelle in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - who they are, when they join the party, their unique mechanic, relationships and role in the story.

sections.title: Who They Are
sections.content:
Maelle joins during Act 1 at Flying Waters and is the fastest melee fighter in the party. Her Battle Stance system rewards constant switching: every stance change gives her +1 AP, so transitions are never wasted.

Joins: Act 1 (Flying Waters)

sections.title: Background
sections.content:
Contains story spoilers - stop here if you have not finished the game.

Maelle is really Alicia Dessendre, Verso's sister. Entering the Canvas overwhelmed her and she was reborn inside it as Maelle, without her memories. Act 3 centres on her, and the single decision that determines which ending you get is a private conversation with her - telling her the truth, or lying. Full breakdown on endings explained.

sections.title: Playable or NPC
sections.content:
Their defining mechanic is Battle Stance - Defensive, Offensive, Virtuose.

Party role: Melee DPS / Support.

Skills, Pictos and stat allocation are covered on the Maelle build guide - this page is the character, not the kit.

In the party tier list they sit at S.

sections.title: Where They Appear
sections.content:

  • Full kit on the Maelle build guide
